original_target.title: Large-data global regularity for creeping-flow Oldroyd–B without stress diffusion

scope_comparison: Wang–Zhang–Zhang August2026 §1 explicitly leaves non-diffusive creeping-flow global regularity open even in two dimensions. Its own large-data theorem retains positive stress diffusion. Corotational weak existence, small-data results and numerical cross-slot stability are not all-positive-definite-data smoothness for the displayed nondiffusive torus system.
